title: Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive
abstract: arXiv:2608.15901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. translated_title: 层至关重要：为什么持续学习正则化应当具有层适应性
translated_abstract: 持续学习正则化器（如EWC）通过惩罚对先前任务参数的更改来对抗遗忘，通常使用逐参数的重要性（如对角Fisher信息）。逐参数方法看似比逐层方法更灵活，但每层的对角Fisher信息只是其实际曲率的一个薄弱摘要，缺少控制遗忘的顶部特征值信息。对抗性比特翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究表明，这种缺失的逐层敏感性在神经网络中跨越多个数量级。在块对角Hessian假设下（即EWC现有对角假设的层级别类比），我们证明了三点：遗忘可分解为按每层顶部Hessian特征值加权的逐层项之和；对角Fisher权重无法恢复该特征值；例如，两个具有相同Fisher平均值的层，其顶部特征值差异可达到层宽度的量级。对于相同水平...
tldr: 本文证明持续学习正则化中逐参数对角Fisher权重无法捕捉各层顶部Hessian特征值，遗忘分解受层级别特征值主导，因此正则化应当采用层适应性策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that per-parameter diagonal Fisher weights fail to capture layer-wise top Hessian eigenvalues, which dominate forgetting decomposition, thus regularizers should be layer-adaptive.
